theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_id_measurable_densities
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) [SFinite μ], Measurable (fun x ↦ limsup (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ Measurable (fun x ↦ liminf (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, MeasurableSet {x | HasDensity n μ x c}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
